recommendations.title: Dual evaluation: adaptive corpus + frozen anchor benchmark
recommendations.why: Historical eval loss is not reliably comparable when the training/evaluation corpus changes between generations.
implementation: Create versioned immutable JANUS_ANCHOR_EVAL with sha256.
Evaluate incumbent and candidate on both current-corpus eval and frozen anchor eval.
Require current-corpus improvement and anchor regression within a frozen tolerance; otherwise HOLD or ABSTAIN.
Persist corpus_digest, anchor_digest, tokenizer/config digest and seed in every lineage record.
gates: Repeated evaluation of one checkpoint on one anchor is deterministic within frozen tolerance.
An easier changed corpus cannot promote a candidate that materially regresses on the anchor.
Historical lineage is explicitly tagged COMPARABLE or NON_COMPARABLE.

recommendations.title: Verifier-stratified bounded replay memory
implementation: Train only from explicit target-local VERIFY_PASS or VERIFY_FAIL carrying proposal hash, verifier version, target head, diff hash and receipt hash.
Keep bounded per-verifier/per-organ replay buckets with capped selector influence and recency decay.
REJECTED_PROVENANCE, STALE_BASE, NO_RECEIPT and TIMEOUT remain non-training states.
Reserve a verified holdout slice for calibration only, never gradient updates.
gates: Replay cannot override a hard verifier failure.
Removing all eligible receipts reproduces baseline selector behavior.

recommendations.title: Hash-chained monotonic durable decision register
implementation: Add decision_epoch, previous_decision_sha256, checkpoint_sha256 and source_run_id to every durable decision.
Accept latest-pointer update only when previous_decision_sha256 equals the current durable head.
On conflict preserve both candidate receipts and reconcile; never resolve solely by timestamp.
Use one canonical latest-pointer writer; all other workflows publish candidate receipts only.
gates: A stale concurrent writer cannot lower decision_epoch or replace latest.
Replay of an accepted decision is idempotent.
Broken previous hash fails closed without discarding evidence.

recommendations.title: Freshness lease with automatic Scout refresh and proposal recomputation
implementation: Scout receipt records repo, observed_head, observed_at, TTL and content-manifest hash.
Before action compare target current HEAD to observed_head.
If stale emit STALE_EVIDENCE, refresh Scout and recompute decision/proposal.
Never auto-rebase an old proposal onto a new target HEAD.
gates: Target HEAD drift triggers refresh/recompute, never patch application.
Unchanged HEAD can reuse a valid lease.

recommendations.title: Event-class receipts for autonomous-life evidence
implementation: Seal event_name, workflow_ref, run_id, run_attempt, head_sha, created_at and actor_class into each life receipt.
Natural-life counter accepts only unique receipts satisfying the frozen schedule policy.
Push, workflow_run and manual activity remain observable but cannot elevate ALIVE_BOUNDED.

recommendations.title: Three-tier research ingestion before training
implementation: Tier A DISCOVERY: raw TOPA/Demi_Head/Fundamentum evidence with source/hash/date.
Tier B CORROBORATED: independent-source grouping, contradiction ledger and provenance score.
Tier C TRAINING_ELIGIBLE: only after a frozen domain-specific gate.
All tiers may inform context; only explicitly eligible fields may affect gradients or selector priors.

recommendations.title: NEXUS organization-wide read/inspect knowledge graph
implementation: Create immutable per-repo manifests with head SHA, relevant file hashes, concepts, tests/workflows and cross-repo references.
NEXUS edges are evidence references, never authority edges.
Mutation stays target-local proposal -> verifier -> receipt.
Every decision records the immutable NEXUS snapshot that informed it.

recommendations.title: Shadow challenger before autonomous promotion
implementation: Run a challenger selector/model on the exact same frozen evidence snapshot without actuation authority.
Compare calibration, verifier-pass, abstention, disagreement and authority metrics.
Promote only against predeclared gates and retain hash-addressable rollback state.

canonical_seal: LEARN FROM VERIFIED OUTCOMES, NOT FROM SELF-BELIEF. KEEP EVIDENCE FRESH, EVALUATION COMPARABLE, MEMORY MONOTONIC, AND AUTHORITY LOCAL.
